Please search for:
1. Any `.sql` files anywhere in the repo (CREATE TABLE, migration scripts, schema.sql, seed data, etc.)
2. Any `Migrations/` folder, EF Core migration classes, or Dapper-based migration runner (e.g. DbUp, FluentMigrator, Evolve)
3. The full `QaAdapter.cs` and its `SqlCommand` struct constants (chatai.Adapter.Chatai.Common/SqlCommand.cs) to see the exact query style used (raw inline SQL strings? stored procedures?)
4. Any README, docs, or comments describing how to add a new table or deploy schema changes to the `chatai` database
5. The full `chatai.Adapter.Chatai/Common/DBConfig.cs` and how `MsSqlProxy` is invoked (dependency injection setup, connection string usage) — I want to know the exact pattern (e.g. `MsSqlProxy.Query<T>(sql, params, connectionStringKey)`) so a new adapter class can follow the same style precisely.

Report back with file paths, line numbers, and code snippets. If there's no migration convention (i.e., schema changes are manual/out-of-band), say so explicitly — this matters for the proposal I'm writing. Keep the report under 400 words plus code snippets.
